# IPv4 (`ipv4`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: variable length
- **Pseudo header**: supplies `src` / `dst` to upper-layer checksums
- **Notes**: [Encapsulation and tunnels](../../protocols/encap.md), [IS-IS (P2)](../../protocols/isis.md), [LDP / RSVP-TE / BFD (P2)](../../protocols/mpls-bfd.md), [Multicast control protocols](../../protocols/multicast.md)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(4)` | `4` |   |   |
| `ihl` | `uint(4)` |   | Length of the header in 32-bit words |   |
| `dscp` | `uint(6)` | `0` |   |   |
| `ecn` | `uint(2)` | `0` |   |   |
| `total_length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets |   |
| `identification` | `uint(16)` | `0` |   |   |
| `flags` | `flags(3)` | `0x0` |   |   |
| `frag_offset` | `uint(13)` | `0` |   |   |
| `ttl` | `uint(8)` | `64` |   |   |
| `protocol` | `enum(8)` | `253` (experimental) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) |   |
| `header_checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Internet checksum over the header |   |
| `src` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.1` |   |   |
| `dst` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.2` |   |   |
| `options` | `tlv` — `ihl * 4 - 20` octets |   |   |   |
| `padding` | `padding(4)` |   |   |   |

| Bit | Mask | Name |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 4 | `reserved` |
| 1 | 2 | `df` |
| 0 | 1 | `mf` |

### `options`

- Type 8 bits, length 8 bits.
- The length counts the type and length fields too.
- Unknown types are kept as raw value octets.

| Type | Name | Value fields | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | `eol` | (type only, no length or value) |   |
| 1 (0x01) | `nop` | (type only, no length or value) |   |
| 148 (0x94) | `router_alert` | `value` |   |

#### `options` › `router_alert`

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `uint(16)` |   |   |   |

## Constraints

| Level | Rule |
|---|---|
| warning | `version` = 4 |
| error | `ihl` within 5..15 |
| warning | `ttl` ≠ 0 |
